edition_notes: Asmodee Group SAS, © Asmodee Group 2026; designed by Kei Kajino and Gilles-Romain Fonteny; French rulebook; 40 cards and 4 player aid cards.

items.rule: Remove cards from the deck according to player count: with 5 players no cards are removed; with 4 players remove all cards bearing one specific setup symbol; with 3 players remove all cards bearing two specific setup symbols.
Give each player one Aide de jeu (player aid) card.
Before each round (manche), shuffle the deck and deal out all the cards; players pick up their cards without showing them to others.
A player may sort their hand in any order at any time but must never flip cards to change their value; cards stay in the orientation in which they were picked up.
The player holding the 1/5 card with the star symbol starts the round; play then proceeds clockwise.
Goal: get rid of all your cards as fast as possible by playing series in front of you.
A series is 1 or more cards with the same active value; its value is that active value and its size is the number of cards.
On your turn, step 1: discard any series in front of you (played on your previous turn), stacking the cards face down near the play area.
On your turn, step 2: perform exactly ONE of four actions: A play a series, B add 1 card to an opponent's series, C take an opponent's series, D flip all cards in your hand.

Action A: play a series from your hand in front of you. If another player already has a series of the same size on the table, yours must have a higher value, and that player takes back all their cards of that series into hand (flipping them).
When playing a series you need not play all cards in your hand of that value.
A series of a size with no existing series on the table can be played regardless of value.
Action B: play exactly 1 card from your hand onto an opponent's series; the card's value must equal the series' value.

Action B: after adding, the enlarged series must have higher value than any other series of the same new size on the table; the owner of the lower-value series takes it back to hand, flipping the cards.
Action C: take an opponent's series from in front of them and add it to your hand, flipping the cards.
Action D: flip all the cards in your hand, swapping their active and inactive values.
Golden rule: whenever you take cards from the table into your hand, you must flip them so the inactive value becomes active (and vice versa) before adding them to your hand.
The first player to get rid of all their cards scores 2 points and stops playing for the rest of the round; their cards remain in front of them for 1 trip around the table before being discarded.
If a series beats the first finisher's series during that trip around the table, their cards are simply discarded.
The second player to get rid of all their cards scores 1 point and the round ends immediately.
Points per round: 2 for the first player out of cards, 1 for the second player out of cards; others score nothing.
The game ends as soon as a player accumulates at least 4 points.
The first player to reach at least 4 points wins the game immediately.

2-player game setup: remove all cards with the three setup symbols (those removed in 3- and 4-player games); each player places 2 player aid cards of the same color in front of them to form zone 1 and zone 2.
2-player game: each player takes 2 consecutive turns, first for zone 1 then for zone 2; at each, discard any series in that zone then take 1 action.
2-player game: each player can have up to two series (one per zone), and a player's series can conflict with the opponent's and with their own series of the same size.
2-player game: the player with the star card starts the round with only one turn, in zone 2 (on their left).
2-player game: a player who gets rid of all cards immediately wins the round; the game is played to 2 round wins.
